identity.name: +972 Magazine
identity.description: An independent Israeli online magazine publishing news, analysis and opinion on Israel-Palestine, human rights and regional politics from a left-wing perspective.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Independent nonprofit funded by readers and grants. Disclosed funders include Heinrich Böll Stiftung Israel, Moriah Fund, Rockefeller Brothers Fund and the Social Justice Fund.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Nonprofit, reader- and grant-funded magazine with an explicit left-wing, human-rights orientation; independent of state or party ownership.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via secondary references (official about page blocked or unavailable); secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No parsed MBFC rating; self-assessed as left based on consistent advocacy for Palestinian rights, ending occupation and civil liberties.
politicalLeaning.source: Analyst assessment from publisher self-description, secondary references and feed-level sample

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic questions are secondary and framed through rights, occupation and social justice.
economicPerspective.source: Analyst assessment from business and economic coverage

internationalAlignment.evidence: Openly aligned with Palestinian rights and Israeli human-rights movements, with a critical stance toward Israeli state policy.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: Established independent magazine with named writers and sourcing, but opinion-heavy and advocacy-oriented; factual claims require cross-checking.
reliability.source: Analyst assessment from ownership, editorial record and feed-level sample

externalRatings.notes: No clean MBFC rating parsed for +972 Magazine.

intelligence.knownPerspective: Left-wing Israeli analysis and commentary focused on occupation, Palestinian rights and the Israeli human-rights movement.

selectionRationale: Adds a critical Israeli civil-society perspective on Palestine that is largely absent from mainstream English-language outlets.

research.researchNotes: Official About page returned 403. Funding details from disclosed funders and Wikipedia. Opinion-heavy content should be weighted accordingly. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
